title: Filter matrix
description: Two filters as one grid, where two dropdowns would be: rows are one dimension (the areas of your tasks), columns the other, usually the shorter (their statuses). A table you compose, as shadcn's Table: FilterMatrix (rows and columns as ids in order, bind:value, onValueChange), FilterMatrixHeader, FilterMatrixBody, FilterMatrixFooter, FilterMatrixRow, FilterMatrixHead (the name of a row or a column; empty, a corner), FilterMatrixCell (one cell, a toggle; its children are the count) and FilterMatrixTotal (a whole row, a whole column, or everything). value is the list of picked cells, each { row, column }; nothing picked means no filter, and matches() says whether a thing passes. A click toggles a cell, a total toggles its whole line, and the second click of a double-click picks only that one. data-state is active or inactive, and partial on a total with some of its line picked; a picked cell is copper, the value in hand. One tab stop: the arrow keys move over every cell and total, Home and End along the row, Space toggles, Enter picks only this one, Escape clears. A cell is named by its two heads; a total needs an aria-label. A row or column that goes takes its picked cells with it. 44px to touch. No copy inside.
